text:
jen: FYI — noticed a small but visible blip in invoice preview for a subset of EU tenants after last night's route-resolver roll. preview shows ~2.8% more tokens in `unattributed` bucket.

david: which change rolled? the v2 fingerprinting that dedupes session ids?

jen: that one. rolled at 02:12 UTC. preview consumer seems to be reading pre-enrichment stream, finalizer reads enriched stream, so preview shows fallback attribution for ~10s windows.

maya: got an example event?

jen: anonymized log: ```event_id: evt_xxx, ts: 1764599123, tenant: eu-rc, session: s_abc, route_resolution: null, tokens: 98```

jen: same session in finalizer shows `route_resolution_id: rsv2-9f3` and attributes to route `search-embed`.

metering-bot: detected 64 preview events with null route_resolution between 1764599000..1764599800 in eu cluster.

alan: sounds like enrichment ordering changed. v2 moved resolver earlier in final pipeline but preview still reads raw topic. timing mismatch.

david: so customers aren't being billed incorrectly, only the preview UI is noisy?

jen: correct — finalized invoices match. but support got a few tickets because they saw preview and panicked.

maya: UX short-term: show a warning on preview when a deployment touches route-resolver in the last X minutes? longer-term we should make preview replicate finalizer logic.

alan: short-term fix: flip preview consumer to read enriched topic in EU as a canary for 30m. long-term: either move enrichment to ingest or ensure enrichment is idempotent and available to both preview and finalizer.

jen: deploying canary now. starting with one partition.

sre-bot: deploy started: preview-consumer->read-enriched.canary.eu (sha: abcdef).

jen: canary metrics: preview delta dropped 2.8% -> 0.3% within 4m.

david: great. I'll add a tiny console flag `preview_enrichment_consistent` and a tooltip: "If false, preview may temporarily misattribute tokens while routing rollouts complete." simple and searchable.

maya: I'll draft a short support blurb and update the preview runbook with reconcile query: `SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) FROM preview WHERE ts>t0 GROUP BY session_id HAVING SUM(tokens) != (SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM final WHERE session_id=preview.session_id)`

alan: also propose tagging events with `inflight_enrichment=true` if they hit the pipeline before enrichment completes; then UI can show them with reduced confidence.

jen: created ticket MP-1129 "preview attribution race with route-resolver v2" assigned to jen/alan/david.

metering-bot: alert: preview_vs_final_delta.eu > 1% at 1764600015.

jen: will keep canary running for 30m and then promote. no billing impact. posting metrics link: https://grafana.internal/d/preview-delta/preview_vs_final

david: after promotion, we'll still prod for a design decision on enrichment placement. logging this as part of the routing rollout postmortem.

maya: thanks all. I'll coordinate the support message and close loop with the CS reporter.

jen: canary stable at 28m. promoting to region. closing here unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

alan: no objections. follow-up: schedule design sync on enrichment placement next week.

jen: thanks everyone.
